name: @andygo.dev/nextjs-harness
description: Local AI development harness for Next.js projects: version-aware manual sync, SQLite/FTS5 search, a Next.js Claude Code Skill, and an MCP server.
author: Andy Kramar <andygo.develop@gmail.com>

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.release: [ "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" = "main" ] || { echo 'Error: not on main branch'; exit 1; } && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'Error: uncommitted changes'; exit 1; } && [ -z "$(git log @{u}..HEAD --oneline)" ] || { echo 'Error: unpushed commits'; exit 1; } && [ -z "$(git log HEAD..@{u} --oneline)" ] || { echo 'Error: local main is behind origin/main'; exit 1; } && npm publish --access public
